description_en: Queries the bandwidths of a website
name: DescribeDomainBps

parameters.help_en:
The region in which your service is deployed. Valid values:

cn: a region in the Chinese mainland.

cn-hongkong: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的请求数据的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的请求数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The interval for returning data. Unit: seconds. Valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is less than 3 days, valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is from 3 to 30 days, valid values are 3600 and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is 31 days or longer, the valid value is 86400. If you leave this parameter empty or specify an invalid value, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的时间粒度，支持300、 3600和86400秒。3天以内（不包含3天整）支持300、 3600、 86400。3-31天（不包含31天整）支持3600和86400。31天以上支持86400。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值
parameters.name: interval

Index.description_en: The index number of the returned data

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
